title: LLM Engineering Expert
description:
Company Description:

Curvia AI is a London, UK-based technology and AI solutions company that transforms complexity into opportunity through enterprise solutions, AI-powered automation, and data-driven insights. We build practical, scalable, and human-centered technology grounded in integrity, security, and responsible innovation

Role Overview

We are seeking experienced AI Evaluation Engineers (Engineering Simulation & Design) to author and validate "model-breaking," simulation-based engineering design problems to train and evaluate state-of-the-art AI agents. Operating across major engineering disciplines—including Electrical, Mechanical, Control Systems, Aerospace, Systems, and Robotics—you will create complex, multi-constraint tasks where AI agents must interpret requirements, navigate trade-offs, configure open-source simulation tools, diagnose failures, and iterate toward valid solutions. You will analyze agent execution logs, expose systemic reasoning gaps, and build automated, objective graders to elevate frontier model performance.

Offer Details:

  • Pay : Pay: US$ 500 per task﻿
  • Mode of work: Fully Remote
  • Number of positions: 200
  • Mode of Employment: Contract/no medical pay
  • Experience : 8-10+ years

Job Requirements:

  • Education & Expertise: Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace, with 10+ years of hands-on engineering design experience.
  • Simulation Tooling: Proficiency with at least one domain-relevant open-source simulation package (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, OpenFOAM, FEniCSx, CalculiX, python-control, CadQuery, build123d, OpenModelica, Cantera, Gmsh) combined with strong Python scripting skills.
  • AI Evaluation & Failure Diagnostics: Hands-on experience with modern LLMs/coding agents and evaluation concepts ( , failure-mode analysis, nondeterministic behavior), with the ability to audit trajectory logs and isolate core reasoning/tool-use failures.
  • Domain Rigor & Precision: Uncompromising attention to physical plausibility, unit consistency, boundary conditions, convergence criteria, and technical documentation.
  • Availability & Commitment: Talent must have weekend on-call availability (part-time engagement is acceptable).
  • Technical Infrastructure: Personal desktop/laptop equipped with a stable, high-speed internet connection in a remote setup.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Model-Breaking Problem Design: Author original, self-contained engineering design tasks with competing constraints, explicit optimization targets, validated reference solutions, and objective autograders.
  • Environment & Simulation Integration: Build, run, and validate problem environments using open-source simulation tools and custom Python test benches.
  • Trajectory Analysis & Failure Mode Taxonomy: Evaluate coding agent outputs and execution logs across repeated trials to identify systemic failure modes (e.g., misinterpreting simulator feedback, premature design convergence, physically impossible geometries).
  • Difficulty Calibration & Benchmark Refinement: Iteratively refine problem difficulty based on empirical model performance data without introducing ambiguity or missing information.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with AI researchers, pod leads, and domain experts to integrate high-rigor benchmarks into the model evaluation pipeline.

Domains

  • Electrical Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Aerospace Engineering
  • Education & ExperienceBachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in any field.
  • Experience in AI evaluation, data annotation, content review, quality assurance, or a related analytical role is preferred but not required.

Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Application form.
  • Finalized talents will go through review & proceed further accordingly.

title: Director, Regional Finance, 9-month contract
description:
Director, Regional Finance, 9-month contract

Vertex Pharmaceuticals (Brazil)

9-month contract position (maternity cover)

Brazil - Hybrid, 3 days on site in Sao Paulo, Brazil (2 days working from home)

Looking for opportunities with purpose, impact and possibilities? Our client, Vertex, is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation. As they grow their pipeline at pace, they are strengthening their reputation for creating transformative medicines for people with serious diseases.

Position Summary

The Director, Regional Finance, will use their business acumen and enterprise leadership mindset to play an active part on the cross-functional country leadership team, with a focus on providing Finance partnering support.

This includes forecasting, performance management, accounting, and internal controls. The role is a key business partner to the Country Manager.

This position is based in Sao Paulo, Brazil, within the Southern Europe and Brazil regional organization. Build key relationships with Global CAO services and act as a liaison with our in-country outsourced providers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Accountable for the administrative, financial, and risk management operations of the affiliate, including the development of a financial and operational strategy, metrics tied to that strategy, and the ongoing development and monitoring of control systems designed to preserve company assets and report accurate financial results.
  • Provide financial leadership to the Brazil entity and drive partnership with local business leads.
  • Part of core deal team working to unlock reimbursement in the country, lead on all financial analysis in support of dossier creation, pricing decisions and reimbursement negotiations.
  • Drive the Brazil financial forecast and financial reporting processes.
  • Actively integrate the corporate planning activities with various business leaders.
  • Develop local goals supporting achievement the overall international goals.
  • Support local team in analysing and driving market KPIs.
  • Partner with local team in setting and controlling field incentive scheme.
  • Driving further finance and accounting input into the revenue forecast for the countries in scope.
  • Provide demand forecast for countries in scope and partner with Supply Chain to optimize stock levels and improve forecast accuracy.
  • Provide effective leadership facilitating collaboration among shared service transactional groups and local stakeholders.
  • Supporting finance and accounting transactional processes in countries such as record to report and source to settle, including forecasting, accruals and training to local teams.
  • Drive rigorous and transparent application of group policies and procedures throughout the countries in scope.
  • Reinforcing a robust internal control framework.
  • Work with international finance and corporate tax on all local tax filings.
  • Assist with statutory accounts filings across legal entity serviced.
  • Participate in external audit and other professional relationships.
  • Coordinate with Global CAO Services on the use of in country outsourced service providers.
  • Develop business cases for strategic investments.
  • Partner with legal to ensure completeness, accuracy and monitoring of contractual arrangements.
  • Participate in assessment and deployment of efficient systems, processes and operations.
  • Participating in global projects representing local needs.
  • Prepare briefing materials for senior management.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Advanced Degree in Accounting or Business administration.
  • Extensive experience in a major company or division of a large corporation, progressively responsible experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or health care industries performing financial planning, sales forecasting, business analytics, or consulting roles.
  • Experience conducting complex analytic assignments in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluency in English and Brazilian languages.
  • A solid understanding of financial valuation techniques as well as experience evaluating alternative investment opportunities and business strategies.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, able to navigate the corporate landscape, quickly establish credibility and build effective, collaborative, working relationships at all levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically, identify key issues and value drivers, and translate strategic insights into an appropriate analytic framework.
  • Ability to partner with other functional areas to develop, improve and monitor compliance with policies and procedures including taking a leadership role on certain initiatives.
  • A track record of proactively identifying problems and gaining consensus on potential solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Advanced knowledge and proficiency of MS Excel (including VBA Macros), MS PowerPoint and financial planning and reporting systems (Hyperion, OBIEE).

Vertex is partnering with Talent Works to manage their international temporary job openings. If you are successful in your application, you will be employed by Talent Works to work on a temporary assignment at Vertex.

title: Pre-Sales Engineer
description:
Job Title: Pre-Sales Engineer (LatAm)

Location: Remote (Based in/near São Paulo, Brazil)

Employment Type: Full-time, Long-term Independent Contractor

Remuneration: USD 1,500 – USD 3,000 / month (Gross, based on experience)

About Wayzim

Wayzim Technology Co., Ltd. () is a leading global provider of intelligent logistics automation solutions. We specialize in advanced sorting systems, conveyor technologies, and smart warehouse infrastructure, serving top e-commerce, express delivery, and 3PL leaders worldwide.

Position Overview

We are looking for a proactive, fast-learning Pre-Sales Engineer based in the São Paulo area to serve as a key technical bridge between our Latin America sales team, regional clients, and HQ mechanical design engineers in China.

In this role, you will lead client technical communications, develop CAD solution layouts, and participate in hands-on site visits across Latin America to help drive business expansion in the region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Solution Design & CAD Layouts: Collaborate closely with China-based mechanical engineers and local sales teams to translate client requirements into technical proposals and accurate 2D/3D CAD layouts.
  • Client Engagement: Join technical discussions, client meetings, and proposal presentations across Latin America to address technical inquiries and clarify scope.
  • On-Site Alignment & Training: Travel to project sites (in Brazil and other LatAm countries) for site surveys, dimensional verification, and hands-on training on Wayzim equipment.
  • Continuous Learning: Actively master Wayzim’s equipment specifications, mechanical structures, and automation workflows to independently drive regional pre-sales technical support.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics , or related engineering fields.
  • Work Experience: Up to 5 years of experience in pre-sales technical support, mechanical design, or project engineering (promising junior candidates are welcome).
  • Software Skills: Proficient in AutoCAD ; familiarity with 3D modeling software (e.g., SolidWorks) is a plus.
  • Language Skills:
  • English: Fluent (written & spoken, required for daily communication with headquarters).
  • Spanish: Conversational to fluent (strong advantage for regional project coverage).
  • Portuguese: Native or fluent.
  • Location & Mobility: Based in or near São Paulo, Brazil . Must hold a valid passport and be willing to travel internationally across Latin America for site visits and equipment training.
  • Key Traits: High self-motivation, strong independent learning capability, and excellent cross-cultural communication skills.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package ( USD 1,500 – USD 3,000 / month ).
  • Flexible remote work model with travel opportunities across Latin America.
  • Direct exposure to cutting-edge global logistics automation technology and large-scale industrial projects.

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada em legalização empresarial, societário e regularização cadastral.
  • Domínio prático de Juntas Comerciais, Receita Federal, REDESIM, DBE, viabilidade, Prefeituras e SEFAZ.
  • Capacidade de interpretar atos societários, exigências, normas e procedimentos administrativos.
  • Experiência na condução simultânea de diferentes processos e clientes, com organização e controle rigoroso de prazos.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia, identificando o próximo passo necessário sem depender de direcionamento constante.
  • Forte senso de responsabilidade sobre as demandas assumidas, acompanhando cada processo até sua efetiva conclusão.
  • Capacidade de identificar problemas antecipadamente e apresentar alternativas de solução.

  • Conhecimento de processos perante órgãos de diferentes Estados brasileiros.
  • Experiência com licenciamento empresarial, Vigilância Sanitária, Corpo de Bombeiros e licenciamento ambiental.

Esperamos que essa pessoa consiga receber um assunto, compreender o objetivo, estruturar as etapas necessárias, executar ou coordenar cada uma delas, acompanhar pendências e conduzir o processo até sua conclusão.

title: Operations Agent
description:
Job Summary

As a Travel Operations Agent , you will support travel agencies, tour operators, and suppliers throughout the pre-stay and reservation process. This role is responsible for handling booking-related requests, resolving operational issues, and ensuring smooth day-to-day operations.

You will work in a fast-paced environment that requires strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining excellent customer service standards.

Job Responsibilities

Reservation Management

  • Monitor and manage reservations through online platforms.
  • Track booking progress and ensure timely resolution of issues.
  • Support the smooth operation of pre-stay activities and reservation processes.

Customer & Supplier Support

  • Provide support to travel agencies, tour operators, and suppliers via email.
  • Handle telephone communication for urgent or critical cases.
  • Deliver professional and timely customer service while maintaining strong relationships with stakeholders.

Operations & Problem Solving

  • Investigate and resolve routine operational issues.
  • Proactively identify and escalate complex cases when necessary.
  • Ensure operational processes are executed accurately and efficiently.

Required Skills

  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of issues.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage a high-volume workload in a controlled and balanced manner.
  • Team-oriented attitude and strong interpersonal skills.

Required Tech Skills

  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Experience using Excel and Outlook.
  • Comfortable working with online reservation and operational platforms.
  • Strong digital literacy and ability to learn new systems quickly.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Previous experience in travel operations, travel agencies, tour operators, hospitality, or related fields.
  • Advanced or fluent English required.
  • Additional languages are considered an advantage.
  • Experience in customer-facing operational environments is preferred.

At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance.

Company Overview

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you’ll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise.

Position Overview

We’re looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect.

Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply.

What You’ll Do

  • Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
  • Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
  • Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
  • Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.

Who You Are

  • A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration.
  • Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST).
  • Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets.
  • Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly.
  • Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up.
  • Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight.
  • Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.

Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.

Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Especialista em contabilidade
description:
Sobre a Vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista Contábil para atuar como a principal referência técnica da área, combinando excelência contábil com visão de negócio. Essa pessoa terá papel fundamental na governança financeira da companhia, apoiando decisões estratégicas, fortalecendo controles internos, garantindo conformidade regulatória e liderando a evolução dos processos e da estrutura financeira em um ambiente dinâmico.

Se você possui forte conhecimento técnico e busca um papel com autonomia e impacto, essa oportunidade pode ser para você!

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como referência técnica contábil, influenciando decisões e garantindo a aderência às melhores práticas contábeis, fiscais e regulatórias.
  • Liderar o processo de fechamento contábil e reporte financeiro do grupo, assegurando qualidade, consistência e confiabilidade das informações apresentadas à liderança e stakeholders.
  • Elaborar, revisar e analisar demonstrações financeiras, notas explicativas, relatórios gerenciais e materiais de suporte à tomada de decisão executiva.
  • Ser responsável pela governança dos processos contábeis, garantindo a conformidade com normas, obrigações fiscais, requisitos regulatórios e políticas corporativas.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor junto à auditoria externa, investidores, consultorias e parceiros especializados, assegurando excelência técnica e agilidade no atendimento das demandas.
  • Avaliar impactos contábeis, financeiros e fiscais de novos produtos, projetos, contratos e iniciativas estratégicas, atuando como parceiro das áreas de negócio e da liderança executiva.
  • Identificar oportunidades de automação, simplificação e evolução de processos, promovendo maior escalabilidade, eficiência operacional e qualidade das informações financeiras.
  • Monitorar alterações regulatórias, fiscais e contábeis, avaliando impactos para o negócio e conduzindo sua implementação junto às áreas envolvidas.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico da área contábil, disseminando conhecimento, elevando padrões de qualidade e contribuindo para a formação das melhores práticas da companhia.
  • Contribuir ativamente para a construção de uma área financeira cada vez mais estratégica, orientada por dados e conectada aos objetivos de crescimento e sustentabilidade do negócio.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Economia, ou áreas correlatas.
  • CRC ativo.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo Híbrido em São Paulo/SP

Habilidades Necessárias

  • Experiencia prévia em SAP HANA, ERP Oracle, Netsuite ou similares.
  • Experiência em contabilidade societária e fechamento contábil.
  • Conhecimento de CPCs, IFRS e legislação contábil brasileira.
  • Experiência com auditoria externa e atendimento a auditorias.
  • Excel avançado.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com forte senso de dono.
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e relacionamento com diferentes stakeholders.
  • Conhecimento com SAP

Habilidades Desejáveis

  • Será um diferencial
  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia, serviços digitais ou ambientes de rápido crescimento.
  • Experiência com projetos de transformação, automação ou melhoria contínua.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente colaborativo e de alta autonomia.
  • Oportunidade de participar de projetos estratégicos.
  • Desenvolvimento profissional contínuo.
  • Pacote de benefícios compatível com o mercado.

title: Analista Administrativo Financeiro
description:
Descrição da vaga

Organização sem fins lucrativos sediada em Campinas busca profissional para atuar na área administrativo-financeira, em uma estrutura enxuta e com contato próximo com a gestão.

Buscamos uma pessoa que vá além da execução das rotinas financeiras. O profissional deverá ter capacidade analítica, raciocínio lógico, domínio avançado de planilhas e autonomia para transformar dados financeiros em informações úteis para a tomada de decisão.

A posição envolve atividades variadas. Mais importante do que ter experiência prévia em todas elas será demonstrar capacidade para compreender problemas, pesquisar soluções, organizar processos e conduzir as demandas com segurança e proatividade.

Horário e Remuneração

CLT 40 horas semanais / dois dias remoto e três dias presencial / Salário base de 4.135,00 / Unimed / Vale Refeição / Totalpass.

Principais Responsabilidades*

• Acompanhar a execução orçamentária, analisando realizado versus planejado e identificando desvios relevantes;

• Preparar relatórios e informações financeiras para apoio à gestão e à Diretoria;

• Elaborar projeções, controles e análises financeiras;

• Acompanhar fluxo de caixa, contas a pagar, recebimentos e aplicações financeiras;

• Organizar centros de custos e apoiar a alocação e o controle de recursos;

• Manter e aprimorar controles e planilhas gerenciais;

• Apoiar processos relacionados a compras, contratos, documentação e rotinas administrativas;

• Dar suporte às rotinas de pessoal, benefícios, férias e demais controles administrativos;

• Interagir com contabilidade, bancos, fornecedores e demais parceiros;

• Identificar necessidades de melhoria nos controles e processos da área e propor soluções..

O que buscamos

• Formação superior em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia, Finanças ou áreas correlatas;

• Experiência em atividades administrativas e financeiras;

• Excel ou outra ferramenta de planilhas em nível avançado;

• Boa capacidade de análise quantitativa e raciocínio lógico-matemático;

• Capacidade de estruturar relatórios e apresentar informações financeiras de maneira clara;

• Organização, atenção aos detalhes e confiabilidade;

• Proatividade e autonomia para investigar problemas e buscar soluções;

• Boa comunicação oral e escrita.

Desejável

• Experiência com elaboração e acompanhamento de orçamento;

• Construção de relatórios gerenciais e indicadores financeiros;

• Experiência em organizações de pequeno ou médio porte, nas quais o profissional tenha atuado de mneira generalista;

• Conhecimentos sobre organizações do Terceiro Setor e prestação de contas.

Perfil desejado

Esta posição é especialmente adequada para quem gosta de compreender os números, questionar resultados e transformar informações dispersas em análises úteis para a gestão.

Procuramos alguém que, diante de uma planilha ou relatório, não se limite a informar os valores, mas seja capaz de perguntar: o que esses números estão mostrando, por que isso aconteceu e o que precisa ser observado ou decidido?

O processo seletivo será conduzido de forma confidencial e poderá incluir uma atividade prática de análise financeira e utilização de planilhas.

  • Apoio à análise de crédito: Analisar processos judiciais de potenciais inquilinos identificados na avaliação de crédito, oferecendo subsídios jurídicos à tomada de decisão.
  • Cobrança de inadimplentes: Acompanhar a atuação das equipes interna e terceirizada de cobrança, apoiando estratégias de recuperação de valores e negociações.
  • Gestão do contencioso: Acompanhar processos judiciais conduzidos por escritórios externos, principalmente ações de despejo, cobrança e trabalhistas, discutindo estratégias e coordenando o fornecimento de informações e documentos pelas áreas internas.

title: Space Control & Transshipment Analyst
description:
Main responsibilities and assignments:

  • Connection Planning & Management:

- Review, plan and coordinate vessel connection schedules with Space Control (SPC) to ensure timely transshipment execution and prevent operational complications.

- Monitor regional ports to guarantee compliance with connection standards, taking into account cargo priorities and port capacity.

- Evaluate and propose strategies to mitigate risks and reduce dwell time at transshipment ports.

  • Operational Monitoring & Coordination:

- Provide consolidated operational reports, identifying critical ports or regional trends that require special attention.

- Share transshipment projections with Marketing/Pricing team to monitor cargo trends across different ports

- Monitor cargo flow (TS) volumes in all LAM ports

- Coordinate with Local offices to implement necessary cargo adjustments (in case of overbookings, move count restrictions or other operational restrictions).

  • Booking Validation & Routing:

- Verify routing logic for bookings

- Control and manage bottlenecks to proactively advise on potential delays or service capacity increases

- Analyze and coordinate with SPC recovery plan for vessels, including necessary adjustments like skip ports or additional cargo discharge.

  • KPI & Regulatory Compliance:

- Measure and report the cargo dwell time across LAM ports and status of any existing operational backlog

- Alert Procurement team related issues generating additional costs from terminal or carrier sources

- Maintain updated knowledge of LAM port regulations to ensure full compliance and avoid penalties or issues impacting the client experience.

  • Regular meetings: with Global Office, Regional Offices (other regions) and LAM countries to align Transshipment strategy.

Degree and specific knowledge:

  • Completed Bachelor's degree (Business Adm/International Trade or similar)
  • Advanced English - essential for seamless communication with Global Office
  • Intermediate Spanish - to interact within Latin America Countries
  • Previous experience with shipping or freight forwarder, ideally dealing with ship space, bookings, logistics or operations
  • Google Sheets and KPI management

Ocean Network Express provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

At Ocean Network Express, we strive toward high-level results for all our employees and pride ourselves on identifying opportunities for internal movement and advancement of proven talent. If you’re interested in a career in the global transportation industry and are looking for growth and advancement opportunities, we encourage you to apply. We enjoy meeting candidates who are persistent in their own professional development.

About Ocean Network Express (ONE)

Ocean Network Express (ONE) was incepted on July 7, 2017, following the liner service integrations of Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha (“K” LINE), Mitsui O.S.K. Lines (MOL) and Nippon Yusen Kaisha (NYK). The new entity functions from its global headquarters in Singapore, supported by regional headquarters in Hong Kong, Singapore, the United Kingdom, the United States, and Brazil. ONE is the world’s seventh-largest container carrier with a fleet size of approximately 1.53 million TEU. Operating more than 200 vessels, it offers an expeditious and reliable international network of over 130 services to 120 countries and beyond. ONE is a member of THE Alliance (THEA), a global ocean carrier consortium.

title: Content Specialist
description:
Our purpose

ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We're a true tech success story, built from the ground up, with a vision to transform the health and safety industry as we know it.

We're also big believers that great companies are built by great people. Our culture has grown organically, shaped by our people and the experiences they bring to the table. Differences are celebrated here, and we believe our diverse perspectives make us stronger as a whole.

Want to know more about ecoPortal? Take a look at our , or watch our for a quick look at who we are and what we're all about.

The opportunity

The Content Specialist is an exciting role in ecoPortal’s marketing team, directly contributing to our content strategy. You’ll be part of a team with big aspirations, changing perceptions of health and safety worldwide.

Ideal for someone who has:

  • A Bachelors (or higher) Degree in marketing/ journalism/ communications or similar major.
  • Exceptional written and verbal English fluency.
  • A strong understanding of SEO and CRO copywriting.
  • A flair for story-telling, with the ability to demonstrate technical writing.

  • Experience in marketing in a tech and/or SaaS company.

  • Experience in managing Podcasts.
  • The ability to meet deadlines, be a self-starter and have a can-do attitude.
  • Great communication skills with the ability to liaise with both internal and external stakeholders regularly.

Key responsibilities

  • Execution of the company’s content strategy, with the aim of educating, engaging, entertaining and empowering people across the company’s full customer lifecycle.

  • Collaborate with other Creative Team members, including Graphic Designers, Video Specialists, as well as members of the Digital Marketing Team.

  • Support the Content Marketing Manager and wider marketing team in other areas of the business that align with your skillset as required.

title: Gerente de contas
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Mapeamento de mercado e identificação de clientes em potencial para os serviços oferecidos no portfólio da empresa;
  • Prospecção e visita de clientes potenciais, identificando novas oportunidades e buscando o crescimento da receita;
  • Desenvolvimento de estratégias comerciais dentro de cada cliente para captação de novos projetos apoiando sempre de forma consultiva para melhor integração da TI ao negócio;
  • Elaboração de propostas comerciais;
  • Negociação de taxas com clientes e profissionais para atingir o target necessário para fechamento do negócio de acordo com as metas estabelecidas;
  • Apoio aos clientes ativos nas rotinas necessárias para que os processos internos sejam atendidos;
  • Negociação de pagamento com clientes inadimplentes;
  • Interface das demandas comerciais com o sistema BullHorn (abertura de oportunidades e abastecimento de informações até o fechamento da oportunidade ou declínio);

O que você precisa ter

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Gestão de Negócios ou áreas afins;
  • Desejável Pós-graduação em Marketing ou área afins;
  • Conhecimento avançado em técnicas de vendas e negociação;
  • Conhecimento avançado nas ferramentas Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint);
  • Excelente capacidade de planejamento, gerenciamento estratégico, foco em resultados, visão de longo prazo, senso de urgência, disciplina, relacionamento interpessoal e resiliência.

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

Executar ações de cobrança ativa, envio de lembretes, negociação com clientes inadimplentes e escalonamento de casos críticos, visando a redução da inadimplência e recuperação de crédito. Efetuar atualização de boletos, emissão de cartas de anuência e apoio na regularização de pendências financeiras.
  • Relacionamento com clientes: Construir e manter relacionamentos positivos com clientes internos e externos, garantindo um atendimento ágil e eficiente. Atuar na resolução de dúvidas e tratativas de divergências, contribuindo para a satisfação e fidelização.

title: Field Service Engineer
description:
About the Job

At GeneMind, we are advancing global precision medicine and scientific discovery through innovative next-generation sequencing (NGS) technology, breaking barriers to deliver reliable, high-performance genomic solutions to laboratories, hospitals, and research institutions across the world.

Our Field Service Engineers are the frontline technical ambassadors of GeneMind, building trusted customer relationships, ensuring maximum instrument uptime, and turning technical expertise into tangible customer success. Working here means joining a mission-driven, fast-growing team where your hands-on skills directly shape the progress of genomics. Surrounded by cutting-edge technology, collaborative colleagues, and meaningful work, you will grow professionally, solve impactful challenges, and build a rewarding career in one of the most dynamic industries today.

Position Summary

Field Service Engineer

Reporting to the Service Manager, the Field Service Engineer will own end-to-end on-site and remote service delivery for GeneMind’s high-precision sequencing instruments. This is a customer-centric, hands-on technical role encompassing installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, hardware troubleshooting, repair, and technical training. You will be responsible for sustaining optimal instrument performance, driving high customer satisfaction, and supporting the reliable operation of genomic testing and research workflows—this is not purely a desk-based role, but a dynamic position requiring field execution and technical problem-solving.

Key Measures Of Success

  • On-time instrument installation & commissioning with zero critical post-installation defects
  • High instrument uptime & fast resolution of hardware-related technical faults
  • Strong customer satisfaction scores and long-term customer loyalty
  • Effective knowledge transfer to distributor service teams and end-user technicians
  • Accurate & compliant service documentation , including maintenance records and repair reports
  • Proactive preventive maintenance execution to minimize unplanned downtime

Position Responsibilities

  • Prepare comprehensive materials, documentation, and packaging for instrument installation, on-site commissioning, and after-sales maintenance, ensuring full readiness for all service activities.
  • Evaluate required supplies, components, and checklists for product demonstrations, coordinate preparation efforts, and follow through to guarantee flawless demo execution.
  • Deliver responsive hardware technical support and maintenance services for customers post-sale, conducting both on-site and remote troubleshooting to resolve malfunctions efficiently.
  • Design and deliver structured technical training for distributor Field Service Engineers and customer laboratory staff, building their capability to operate and maintain instruments independently.
  • Perform routine on-site inspections to assess instrument operating status, proactively identify potential issues, and assist customers in maintaining consistent, reliable instrument performance.
  • Maintain detailed, accurate service records, project documents, and technical reports in compliance with company policies and quality management standards.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, application, and R&D teams to share customer feedback, resolve complex technical issues, and improve overall product reliability and customer experience.

Listed responsibilities are an essential, but not exhaustive list, of the usual duties associated with the position. Changes to individual responsibilities may occur due to business needs.

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Automation, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Semiconductor, Mechatronics, or related technical disciplines .
  • 3+ years of hands-on hardware maintenance experience in medical devices, precision analytical instruments, or life science equipment.
  • Proficiency in instrument assembly, disassembly, circuit troubleshooting, mechanical calibration, and hardware fault resolution for high-precision equipment.
  • Excellent verbal communication skills, with the ability to draft clear, compliant project documents, service reports, and technical records independently.
  • Strong learning agility and adaptability, with the ability to quickly master complex genomic sequencing instruments and emerging technical knowledge.
  • Good oral English proficiency; fluent English skills are highly preferred to support global customers and cross-regional collaboration.
  • Willing and able to travel frequently domestically and internationally as required to fulfill service obligations.
  • Customer-focused mindset, strong sense of responsibility, attention to detail, and professional work ethic with a commitment to quality service.

All listed requirements are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodations for additional tasks and responsibilities.

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Prior experience servicing NGS sequencers, PCR instruments, or other laboratory genomic/analytical equipment is strongly preferred.
  • Experience delivering technical training, supporting distributor service teams, or managing multi-site service operations.
  • Familiarity with medical device quality systems, including ISO13485, GMP, or relevant regulatory compliance standards.
  • Advanced hands-on expertise with electrical, mechanical, and optical components of precision laboratory instruments.
  • Experience supporting global customers or cross-cultural technical collaboration.
  • Proactive problem-solving skills and ability to work independently with minimal supervision in field settings.

Who We Are

GeneMind is a leading global innovator and manufacturer of next-generation sequencing (NGS) systems, powered by independent core intellectual property. We develop and deliver high-performance, reliable sequencing solutions to empower precision medicine, scientific research, and public health initiatives worldwide.

We are deeply committed to fostering an inclusive, supportive workplace that values diversity, professional growth, and collaborative innovation. We prioritize employee development, encourage curiosity, and empower every team member to make a meaningful impact on our mission to advance genomic technology for global health equity.

Equal Opportunity Employer : We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Customs Manager (Brazil)
description:
Job Responsibilities

1. Fully establish and implement the customs compliance system for JD Industrial’s Brazil business. Be proficient in Brazilian customs regulations and Mercosul rules, ensure full compliance of import and export customs clearance for industrial materials, MRO products and equipment spare parts, and effectively control customs risks including customs inspection, cargo detention and fines.

2. Take charge of HS code classification verification, tariff determination and application of rules of origin to optimize tax cost calculation. Examine full sets of customs clearance documents including invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin and licensing documents. Cooperate with and manage local customs brokers, and conduct regular performance evaluation of third-party service providers.

3. Keep real-time track of updates on Brazilian customs policies, tariffs, import licenses and product certification regulations. Deliver policy interpretation and business response solutions, organize internal customs compliance training, and conduct pre-assessment for new projects and new product access.

4. Independently handle all kinds of emergency customs issues such as customs inspections, audits, cargo detention and objection appeals. Act as the company’s representative to communicate and negotiate with Brazilian customs, tax and supervision authorities to minimize business losses.

5. Collaborate with procurement, supply chain, finance and local operation teams to improve customs clearance efficiency and reduce overall customs and logistics costs. Compile regular customs KPI reports covering clearance efficiency, inspection rate, cost analysis and abnormal issue statistics to support business decision-making.

6. Promote the digitalization of customs clearance processes, connect with local ERP and logistics systems, and complete standardized customs file management. Participate in the preparation and maintenance of Brazil AEO certification, and summarize localized customs SOPs to support the business expansion in South America.

7. Responsible for daily management, task arrangement, training and performance assessment of the customs team, and build a localized customs talent echelon in Brazil.

Job Requirements

1. Bachelor’s degree or above, major in International Trade, Supply Chain Management, Customs Administration, Logistics or related fields is preferred. Possess 5+ years of customs management experience, with at least 3 years of hands-on customs management experience in Brazil ; candidates with experience in industrial products, MRO and equipment customs business are highly preferred.

2. Mandatory Language Skills: Fluent in business Portuguese and English (oral and written) for independent business communication, email correspondence and cross-border meetings. Proficient in Chinese is a prominent advantage.

3. In-depth knowledge of Brazilian import procedures, HS classification, tariff system, import licensing requirements and Mercosul regulations. Familiar with Brazilian customs audit mechanisms with practical experience in customs appeal and complex abnormal issue handling; AEO certification experience is a plus.

4. Experienced in managing customs brokers and third-party service providers. Possess strong risk identification capability, rigorous compliance awareness, and the ability to independently solve complex customs technical problems.

5. Excellent cross-cultural communication and cross-departmental collaboration skills, high stress tolerance and result-oriented mindset. Proficient in Excel for customs data analysis and report generation.

6. Preferred qualifications: Familiar with the business operation model of Chinese enterprises investing in Brazil and the internal collaboration logic of Chinese-funded enterprises; holding professional certificates in international trade or customs declaration is a plus.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

title: 【Brzail】Brazil Business Development Manager (MJ000025)
description:
Business Development Manager

About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated Business Development Manager to join our growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities, building strategic partnerships, and expanding our presence in the Brazilian and international e-commerce ecosystem.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with cross-border e-commerce and marketplace sellers, understands the dynamics of international online marketplaces, and is passionate about helping businesses grow globally.

Key Responsibilities

· Identify, develop, and manage relationships with new merchants and strategic partners.

· Drive business growth by acquiring and onboarding new sellers.

· Work closely with Brazilian merchants selling through international marketplaces such as Amazon US, Walmart Marketplace, eBay, Etsy, TikTok Shop, Temu, and AliExpress .

· Develop relationships with international merchants expanding into the Brazilian market through leading local marketplaces such as Mercado Livre, Shopee, Amazon Brazil, Magalu, Americanas Marketplace, Casas Bahia Marketplace, Carrefour Marketplace, Shein, and AliExpress Brazil .

· Understand merchants’ business needs and recommend solutions that drive growth.

· Coordinate with internal product, operations, and marketing teams to deliver an excellent customer experience.

· Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and emerging opportunities within the cross-border e-commerce ecosystem.

· Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and partner meetings when required.

Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university.

· Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required.

· Mandarin Chinese proficiency is a plus.

· Proven experience in Business Development, Partnerships, Account Management, or Sales within the e-commerce, fintech, payments, or marketplace industries.

· Strong experience working with:

o Brazilian sellers expanding through international marketplaces such as Amazon US, Walmart Marketplace, eBay, Etsy, TikTok Shop, Temu, and AliExpress .

o International merchants selling through Brazilian marketplaces including Mercado Livre, Shopee, Amazon Brazil, Magalu, Americanas Marketplace, Casas Bahia Marketplace, Carrefour Marketplace, Shein, and AliExpress Brazil .

· Strong understanding of cross-border e-commerce operations, marketplace ecosystems, and merchant acquisition.

· Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.

· Self-motivated, entrepreneurial mindset, and results-oriented.

· Ability to work in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience in cross-border e-commerce, international payments, fintech, or logistics.

· Existing network of marketplace sellers, agencies, aggregators, or e-commerce service providers.

· Experience working with marketplace APIs, seller tools, or international expansion projects is an advantage.

What We Offer

· Opportunity to work in a fast-growing international company.

· Exposure to global e-commerce and fintech markets.

· Collaborative, entrepreneurial, and multicultural work environment.

· Competitive compensation package and career growth opportunities.

If you are passionate about cross-border commerce and enjoy building strategic partnerships that drive business growth, we would love to hear from you.

title: Arquiteto Trainee Recém Formado | Construtora e Incorporadora
description:
Sobre a empresa

Construtora e incorporadora líder no segmento popular, com atuação destacada no mercado imobiliário do Rio Grande do Sul.

Hoje, a empresa possui 6 canteiros ativos e plano de expansão para 10 canteiros até 2028 . É referência no uso de soluções de engenharia, tecnologia e padronização construtiva, com forte atuação em empreendimentos do programa Minha Casa, Minha Vida , além de projetos no Médio/Alto Padrão.

A empresa possui alta velocidade de vendas e um pipeline relevante de novos lançamentos. Nesse contexto, a área de Projetos, Licenciamento e Aprovação tem papel estratégico para garantir previsibilidade, velocidade e segurança na aprovação dos empreendimentos, viabilizando novos lançamentos e reduzindo riscos regulatórios.

IMPORTANTE: A vaga NÃO É na Alfaiate Consultoria em Estratégia.

Missão do cargo

Conduzir e apoiar os processos de licenciamento, aprovação e regularização de empreendimentos imobiliários , garantindo o avanço dos projetos junto a órgãos públicos, concessionárias, cartórios, Caixa Econômica Federal e demais agentes envolvidos.

O cargo tem como missão assegurar que os empreendimentos avancem com agilidade, conformidade técnica e visão de viabilidade , contribuindo diretamente para o cronograma de lançamentos da incorporadora, especialmente em projetos do segmento MCMV / popular .

Principais responsabilidades

Licenciamento e aprovação de empreendimentos

  • Conduzir processos de aprovação de projetos junto a Prefeituras, Secretarias, concessionárias e demais órgãos públicos
  • Acompanhar protocolos, exigências, pareceres, complementações e prazos de aprovação
  • Atuar no destravamento de pendências técnicas, documentais e institucionais
  • Apoiar a obtenção de alvarás, licenças, habite-se, aprovações urbanísticas e demais documentos necessários
  • Garantir organização e rastreabilidade dos processos de licenciamento e aprovação

Projetos legais e interface técnica

  • Apoiar a elaboração, revisão e compatibilização de projetos legais
  • Analisar diretrizes urbanísticas, índices construtivos, zoneamento, recuos, vagas, áreas computáveis e demais parâmetros municipais
  • Avaliar restrições técnicas e regulatórias de terrenos e empreendimentos
  • Apoiar estudos preliminares de implantação, massa e viabilidade urbanística
  • Fazer interface com projetistas, engenharia, incorporação, jurídico, comercial e diretoria

Viés de incorporação e MCMV

  • Atuar com visão de produto imobiliário, considerando viabilidade, padrão construtivo, legislação e enquadramento no MCMV
  • Apoiar análises relacionadas a enquadramento de empreendimentos em faixas e exigências do programa
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de produtos compatíveis com exigências de aprovação, Caixa e mercado
  • Antecipar riscos de aprovação que possam impactar cronograma, lançamento, financiamento ou viabilidade do empreendimento
  • Apoiar a padronização de soluções para acelerar aprovações futuras

Caixa, cartórios e agentes externos

  • Apoiar demandas relacionadas à aprovação e enquadramento de empreendimentos junto à Caixa Econômica Federal
  • Organizar documentos técnicos necessários para processos de financiamento, crédito associativo e análise de engenharia
  • Fazer interface com cartórios, registro de imóveis e demais agentes envolvidos na regularização dos empreendimentos
  • Acompanhar exigências documentais e técnicas para registro, incorporação e avanço dos projetos

Gestão de prazos, processos e informações

  • Controlar cronogramas de aprovação dos empreendimentos
  • Manter atualizados checklists, status de processos, pendências e responsáveis
  • Construir relatórios de acompanhamento para liderança e diretoria
  • Sinalizar riscos, gargalos e atrasos com antecedência
  • Propor melhorias nos fluxos internos de aprovação e licenciamento

Requisitos

  • Formação completa em Arquitetura e Urbanismo
  • Experiência com aprovação de projetos, licenciamento ou regularização de empreendimentos imobiliários
  • Conhecimento de legislação urbanística, códigos de obras, zoneamento e parâmetros municipais
  • Experiência com interface junto a Prefeituras, Secretarias, concessionárias, cartórios e/ou Caixa Econômica Federal
  • Capacidade de leitura e análise crítica de projetos legais, arquitetônicos e urbanísticos
  • Boa organização para acompanhar múltiplos processos simultaneamente
  • Boa comunicação para interface com áreas internas, projetistas e agentes externos
  • Perfil proativo, resolutivo e com capacidade de buscar ajuda e destravar problemas
  • Atenção aos detalhes e senso de responsabilidade com prazos críticos

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em construtora, incorporadora ou mercado imobiliário
  • Experiência com empreendimentos do programa Minha Casa, Minha Vida
  • Conhecimento sobre crédito associativo, aprovação Caixa e rotinas de incorporação imobiliária
  • Experiência com aprovação de loteamentos, condomínios, empreendimentos multifamiliares ou projetos de parede de concreto
  • Conhecimento em Sienge, AutoCAD, Revit, ferramentas de gestão de projetos ou sistemas de protocolo municipal
  • Vivência com estudos de massa, viabilidade urbanística e análise de terrenos
  • Experiência em relacionamento com órgãos públicos e gestão de exigências técnicas

Perfil comportamental

Buscamos uma pessoa com perfil técnico, organizado e com forte capacidade de articulação.

O perfil ideal combina:

  • Comunicação clara e objetiva , especialmente para lidar com áreas internas, projetistas e órgãos externos
  • Proatividade para buscar informações, ajuda e soluções , sem esperar o problema escalar
  • Organização e disciplina para controlar muitos processos, prazos e pendências ao mesmo tempo
  • Capacidade de destravar problemas , acompanhando exigências até a resolução
  • Atenção técnica aos detalhes , evitando retrabalho, inconsistências e atrasos

Remuneração e modelo

  • Contratação CLT
  • Até 13º, 14º e 15º salários
  • Pacote de benefícios
  • Atuação presencial na sede da empresa
  • Jornada de segunda a quinta-feira, das 8h às 18h, e sextas-feiras, das 8h às 17h

description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Role Mission

As a Fiat Operations Specialist, you will be responsible for driving the integration of local payment methods that allow users to deposit and withdraw BRL. You will collaborate closely with product, compliance, and tech teams to improve the fiat on&off-ramp experience for users. A key aspect of this role is working with the product team to identify opportunities to build the smooth user experience, ensuring that payment flows are intuitive, seamless, and aligned with customer and regulatory needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage BRL on/off-ramp channels end-to-end, ensuring availability, performance, and reliability.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for brazilian banks and payment vendors, payment service providers (PSPs), card processors, and other fiat partners, managing relationships, negotiations, and day-to-day communication to ensure reliable and efficient payment channels.
  • Lead and coordinate technical integrations with local banks and payment gateways, working alongside engineering and product teams to ensure seamless implementation and ongoing maintenance of payment infrastructure;
  • Ensure seamless user access to fiat products, minimizing friction in deposits and withdrawals.
  • Monitor and manage the end-to-end operational process for fiat on&off-ramps, ensuring smooth transactions and rapid issue resolution for users.
  • Identify emerging trends in user preferences, and regulatory changes in Brazil to adapt our platform accordingly.
  • Work closely with Customer Support to resolve user issues related to deposits, withdrawals, and transaction status, including handling workflows and tickets raised by the CS team that are related to fiat operations.
  • Maintain strong relationships with banking partners, payment service providers (PSPs), card processors, and other fiat partners.
  • Ensure liquidity and operational stability of BRL fiat flows and payment channels.
  • Use data and metrics to optimize payment integrations, minimize friction for users, and enhance the overall user experience;
  • Work closely with the product team to improve the overall user experience of fiat on&off-ramp processes. Provide insights and feedback based on user behavior, transaction data, and customer feedback to inform product enhancements that improve payment flow, reduce friction, and increase user satisfaction.
  • Support fiat on/off-ramp operations for additional currencies (e.g., ARS and others), as applicable.
  • Monitor daily fiat operations, ensuring accurate processing, timely settlements, and proper reconciliation between internal systems and external partners.
  • Coordinate card and payment infrastructure partners for Brazilian users, ensuring smooth operation of payment flows, supporting issue resolution and complaints handling, and actively participating in the design and improvement of these processes.
  • Maintain and improve operational controls (limits, reconciliation routines, cut-off times, monitoring alerts).
  • Identify, investigate, and resolve operational incidents, ensuring proper escalation and root cause analysis.
  • Keep SOPs, runbooks, and operational documentation up to date and aligned with actual processes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Technology, Risk, and Compliance teams to improve fiat infrastructure and processes.
  • Act as a key advocate for the user experience, ensuring that payment-related touchpoints are designed to be intuitive, frictionless, and aligned with user needs and expectations.

Requirements

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in payment operations, banking, fintech in Brazil.
  • Payments&Banking Background: Demonstrated experience in the payments or banking industry, with a strong understanding of the brazilian financial ecosystem, local payment rails, and banking operations;
  • Technical Integration Experience: Hands-on experience coordinating technical integrations with banks, payment providers; ability to bridge communication between technical and business teams.
  • Regulatory Awareness: Familiarity with brazilian financial regulations, anti-money laundering practices, KYCcompliance, and payment industry standards.
  • Project Management: Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Problem Solving: Analytical thinker with a proactive approach to identifying issues and implementing effective solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and liaise with internal and external stakeholders including banks and vendors.
  • Languages: Fluency in both English and Portuguese is required (written and verbal). Additional languages are a plus.

Why Join Us

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

Our benefits include:

- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.

- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.

- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.

- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.

- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

title: Customer Experience Specialist
description:
Build the future of payments with AI, Pix & Open Finance

Type: Full-Time

Language: English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

Reports to: CPO/Product Manager

The Company

Nova is building a new generation payment network (i.e. reinventing Visa/Mastercard) using AI on top of Pix and Open Finance.

Its first product is a B2C digital wallet that functions as an infrastructure bridge between traditional credit cards and Pix, allowing consumers to use their existing credit card limits anywhere, even to pay Pix and Boletos in installments.

The company was founded by an elite team of fintech veterans and has had top-tier venture capital investors (Monashees, Canary, Canaan and Propel) since its inception.

We recently raised a large Series A and are now assembling a small team of exceptional experienced professionals to build, launch and grow its next generation of products.

The Role

We’re looking for a Customer Experience Specialist to own how Nova shows up for its customers, from the first support message to the public review that comes after it.

This role goes beyond basic ticket handling. Our first line of support is an AI agent, and a big part of your role is making it better every week: finding where it fails, feeding it the right answers, and stepping in yourself when a human is genuinely needed.

You'll own everything around it — our reputation on the App Store, Google Play and ReclameAqui, proactive outreach when a customer’s situation calls for it, and bringing what you hear back to Product and Marketing so we fix the root cause.

You’ll be the voice of the customer inside a small, fast-moving fintech team, with real ownership from day one.

This role is perfect for someone who:

  • Is genuinely obsessed with customer satisfaction
  • Uses AI to work better and faster, not just because it’s trendy
  • Wants to build a support operation, not just staff one

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop our AI support agent: continuously improve the AI agent that handles our first line of support — reviewing conversations, identifying gaps and failure cases, refining answers and knowledge base content, and raising the share of cases resolved without human help;
  • Handle escalations: personally respond to the cases where a human is required, with care, accuracy and speed;
  • Own our public reputation: monitor and respond across App Store, Google Play and ReclameAqui, and be accountable for our scores and response times on those channels;
  • Proactive outreach: reach out directly to customers in specific situations — failed payments, incidents, high-value or at-risk users — before they have to come to us;
  • Lead the Monthly Customer Support Meeting: prepare the data, surface the main pain points and trends, and drive follow-ups to completion;
  • Work side-by-side with Product Managers and Marketing: turn support signal into product fixes and clearer communication, and make sure customer-facing messaging matches what customers actually experience;
  • Keep things organized: support macros, help center content, processes and metrics — documented and up to date.

The Qualifications

Required:

  • Obsessed with customer satisfaction — you take it personally when someone has a bad experience;
  • Excellent Portuguese writing & communication skills — clear, warm and firm in the same message;
  • Great verbal communication — comfortable on the phone, on a call, and in front of the team. You'll be leading initiatives and reporting;
  • Comfortable with English (intermediate is enough — we work internally in English);
  • AI Native and Enthusiast: you already use AI tools to make your own work better and more efficient (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.), and you’re excited about shaping an AI agent rather than competing with it;
  • Organized and autonomous — you can own a process end to end without being chased;
  • Strong team player, curious and proactive.

Preferred:

  • Previous experience in customer support, customer success or customer experience — ideally in fintech, banking or a high-volume consumer app;
  • Familiarity with support tooling (Intercom, Zendesk or similar) and reputation channels (ReclameAqui, app store reviews);
  • Comfort with data: able to pull, read and present support metrics (volume, CSAT, first response time, resolution rate);
  • Experience dealing with sensitive topics — payments, charges, fraud, disputes;
  • Fast learner who thrives in dynamic, ambitious environments.

How You Work

  • Collaborative: open, communicative, team-oriented
  • Customer-obsessed: you listen closely and follow through
  • AI Native: you automate the repetitive so you can focus on what matters
  • Ambitious: eager to grow quickly and deliver impact
  • Owner mindset: you fix the root cause, not just the ticket

Other Requirements

  • Location: 3x per week (Tue, Wed, Thu) at our office in São Paulo
  • English mandatory

The Offer Package

  • Model: PJ
  • Compensation: aggressive salary
  • Stock Option: aggressive stock option grants
  • Other Benefits: premium health insurance, flexible hours, paid vacations and Wellhub

If you're excited about building the rails of the next generation payment network alongside a small team of high-caliber, highly motivated professionals, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Remote Litigation Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's dispute resolution work in Brazil: commercial contract disputes, shareholder and post-M&A disputes, technology and IP disputes, debt recovery, and arbitration.
  • Lead case strategy, pleadings, evidence, and procedural steps for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies.
  • Advise clients on litigation risk before disputes arise — contract audits, escalation strategy, settlement positioning, and dispute resolution clauses.
  • Draft and negotiate letters before action, settlement agreements, and standstill and tolling arrangements; represent clients in mediation, arbitration, and court proceedings where licensed to do so.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising commercial litigation or arbitration in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with contract disputes — breach, termination, damages, limitation of liability, and injunctive relief.
  • Advocacy and procedure. Confident managing proceedings end-to-end, with rights of audience or substantial arbitration experience (ICC, LCIA, or local institutions).
  • Strong drafting under pressure. Pleadings, witness statements, and settlement terms that hold up.
  • Commercial judgment. You know when to fight, when to settle, and how to explain the difference to a client.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Bring modern tooling to dispute work — faster case preparation, sharper strategy, and clients who value clarity over billable churn.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Bilingual Case Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly organized Case Manager to join our growing legal team in the Pre-Litigation Department . This is a fully remote opportunity for a professional with a strong background in personal injury case management , medical records coordination, and client communication.

The ideal candidate will have proven experience managing personal injury cases from intake through pre-litigation resolution, preparing demand packages, coordinating with medical providers, and supporting successful case outcomes. Strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and the ability to manage a high-volume caseload are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with attorneys and legal staff to prepare files for litigation when necessary.
  • Provide administrative and case management support to the pre-litigation team.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience as a Case Manager in Personal Injury Law .
  • Proven experience handling personal injury cases during the pre-litigation phase.
  • Strong experience obtaining, organizing, and reviewing medical records, medical bills, and liens.
  • Experience preparing demand packages and assisting with settlement negotiations.
  • Solid understanding of personal injury pre-litigation processes and workflows.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and legal case management software.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with attorneys, clients, medical providers, and insurance companies.
  • Bilingual English and Portuguese.

Responsibilities include reconciliation, accounts payable, and receivable for the Brazilian office as well as other company offices. Working closely with the finance team, the individual will ensure accuracy and efficiency in all financial processes.   • Prepare recurring financial reports, including:

- IOF reports;

- Bank charges analysis;

- Expensify reports;

- QuickBooks reports;

- Billable payables due from WTI.

  • Generate and distribute the monthly Expensify KPI report, monitoring reimbursement performance and compliance metrics.

• knowledge of financial forecasting and diagnosis, corporate finance and information analysis
